backlog.title: Adversarial QA Remediation — geoform 0.2.0 Bug Fixes
backlog.description: Remediate the 4 pre-existing defects (2 Major, 2 Minor) identified during the adversarial QA pass of the geoform implementation against PRD v1 with the 0.2.0 hostable-viewport delta. Baseline: tsc clean, 294/294 tests pass. No critical issues — core open/submit/cancel/nest/state-preservation/breadcrumbs/hostable-viewport all work.

milestones.title: Major Defect Fixes
milestones.description: Fix the two Major issues: (1) form-invoked onError mutates the stack and rejects openForm() violating PRD §9; (2) concurrent cancel requests orphan the first confirmation promise. Both are deterministic, affect documented public APIs, and have zero test coverage.

tasks.title: Fix form-invoked onError to comply with PRD §9 (Issue 1)
tasks.description: Decouple the form-invoked onError from stack mutation. Currently FormStackRenderer.handleError rejects the openForm() deferred and immediately pops the form, violating PRD §9 ('Errors do not mutate stack state automatically'). The fix routes the error into the existing FormErrorBoundary so its compliant Retry/Dismiss UI handles it, keeps the form mounted, and does not reject openForm().

subtasks.title: Add imperative showError(error) method to FormErrorBoundary
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: See plan/002_32eb66cd705d/bugfix/001_f635210a7f29/architecture/issue_analysis.md §Issue 1 and architecture/system_context.md §Error Handling. FormErrorBoundary (src/components/FormErrorBoundary.tsx) is a React class component. It already has getDerivedStateFromError(error) that sets { hasError: true, error }. A public instance method that calls this.setState({ hasError: true, error }) will trigger the same re-render path and display the existing Retry/Dismiss fallback UI. No forwardRef is needed — refs to class components give direct instance access in React 18/19.
2. INPUT: No inputs from other subtasks. This is the foundation subtask. The FormErrorBoundary class already has FormErrorBoundaryState { hasError: boolean; error: Error | null; retryCount: number } and a handleRetry method that clears hasError and increments retryCount.
3. LOGIC: Add a new public instance method to the FormErrorBoundary class:
   ```ts
   /**
    * Imperatively display the error fallback UI for a non-render error
    * (e.g. a form-invoked onError). Sets the same state as
    * getDerivedStateFromError so the existing Retry/Dismiss UI appears.
    *
    * Note: componentDidCatch and the onError prop callback do NOT fire for
    * imperatively-set errors (no React error was caught). Callers should
    * handle their own logging before calling this method.
    */
   showError(error: Error): void {
     this.setState({ hasError: true, error });
   }
   ```
   Write a failing test first: render FormErrorBoundary with children, obtain a ref, call ref.current.showError(new Error('test')), assert the fallback UI appears (getByRole('alert'), getByText('test')). Then implement. Verify that clicking Retry clears the error and re-renders children, and that clicking Dismiss calls the onDismiss prop. Import the type FormErrorBoundaryHandle or use InstanceType<typeof FormErrorBoundary> for the ref type in tests.
4. OUTPUT: FormErrorBoundary now exposes a public showError(error: Error) instance method. Consumers with a ref to the boundary can imperatively trigger the error fallback UI. The class type FormErrorBoundary can be used as a ref target (e.g. React.RefObject<FormErrorBoundary>). Export the class type from src/components/index.ts if not already exported.
5. DOCS: [Mode A] Update the JSDoc on the FormErrorBoundary class (src/components/FormErrorBoundary.tsx) to document the new showError(error) method, noting it is for non-render errors (form-invoked onError path) and that componentDidCatch/onError do not fire for it.

subtasks.title: Rework FormStackRenderer.handleError to route errors to FormErrorBoundary instead of rejecting/popping

tasks.title: Fix concurrent confirmation request orphaning (Issue 2)
tasks.description: When a second cancel/popToIndex request arrives while a confirmation dialog is already open, the single-slot PendingConfirmation state is overwritten, orphaning the first request's resolve callback so its promise never settles. The fix coalesces concurrent waiters onto a single dialog.

subtasks.title: Coalesce concurrent confirmation waiters in FormStackProvider

milestones.title: Minor Defect Fixes
milestones.description: Fix the two Minor issues: (3) useFormStackViewport() leaks internal component and deferred types, contradicting PRD §10.1 'no internal-type leakage'; (4) duplicate form ids collide on React key with no development guard.

tasks.title: Fix useFormStackViewport() type leakage (Issue 3)
tasks.description: The low-level public hook useFormStackViewport() returns FormStackViewportValue whose stack field is typed InternalStackEntry<unknown>[], exposing component, deferred.resolve/reject, and confirmOnCancel. The fix separates the internal context value type (needed by the renderer) from the public hook return type (sanitized to StackEntry[]), so consumers cannot hijack form resolution.

subtasks.title: Define internal context value type and sanitize public FormStackViewportValue
Update useFormStackViewport hook to map internal-to-public and fix FormStackViewport + tests

tasks.title: Add development-mode duplicate form ID guard (Issue 4)
tasks.description: Pushing two forms with the same id produces a React duplicate-key warning in FormStackRenderer and Breadcrumbs (both key by entry.id). The fix adds a development-mode console.warn in openForm when an id already present on the stack is pushed again.

subtasks.title: Add dev-mode duplicate ID warning in FormStackProvider.openForm

subtasks.title: Update README.md error handling, FormStackViewportValue, and error boundary sections
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: See plan/002_32eb66cd705d/bugfix/001_f635210a7f29/architecture/system_context.md §Documentation Targets. README.md has sections at: Error Boundaries (~line 737), FormStackViewportValue (~line 603), FormErrorBoundary (~line 245), FormProps (~line 496), and Hostable Viewport (~line 791). All four fixes have documentation implications.
2. INPUT: All four issues are now fixed. The specific changes to document:
   - Issue 1: onError now surfaces to FormErrorBoundary (Retry/Dismiss) instead of rejecting openForm() and popping. The README 'Error Boundaries' section currently says 'onError is called when the error boundary catches an error' which is incorrect — onError is called BY the form component and routed TO the boundary.
   - Issue 2: No user-facing behavior change (internal re-entrancy fix) — but the confirmation dialog now correctly handles concurrent requests.
   - Issue 3: FormStackViewportValue.stack is now readonly StackEntry[] (no component/deferred). The README type definition block must be updated.
   - Issue 4: Duplicate IDs now produce a dev-mode warning.
3. LOGIC:
   a) README.md 'Error Boundaries' section (~line 737): Correct the onError description. Change from 'onError is called when the error boundary catches an error' to explain that a form calls its injected onError prop to signal an error, which is routed to the surrounding FormErrorBoundary showing Retry/Dismiss UI — the stack is not mutated and openForm() does not reject (PRD §9).
   b) README.md 'FormStackViewportValue' section (~line 603): Update the type definition code block to show the sanitized interface (stack: readonly StackEntry[], onClose: () => void). Remove the InternalStackEntry note and onCancelRequest from the public type. Add a note that the public hook returns only id/label entries.
   c) README.md 'FormErrorBoundary' section (~line 245): Add showError(error) to the documented public methods/props if the README lists them. Update the props table or add a methods section.
   d) README.md OpenFormOptions section or 'Common Pitfalls': Add a note about duplicate IDs producing a development-mode warning.
4. OUTPUT: README.md accurately reflects all four fixes. No stale documentation about onError rejecting, InternalStackEntry leaking, or missing duplicate-ID guard.
5. DOCS: This IS the documentation task — no further docs action needed within this subtask.
